title: Recording: Junk, Singalong Junk by Paul McCartney | 1970
content:
Paul McCartney recorded the songs ‘Junk’ and ‘Singalong Junk’ on 17 January 1970.

It was written in Rishikesh, India, in 1968, but only partly finished. A demo had been recorded ahead of the White Album sessions in May that year.

McCartney recorded three versions on this day. Take one had acoustic rhythm guitar, lead guitar, piano, and bass guitar. Take two was similar but had vocals instead of the piano. The final attempt was a single guitar take but was otherwise incomplete.

More overdubs were added on 18 February, and the first two takes were released on McCartney’s debut solo album McCartney, as ‘Singalong Junk’ and ‘Junk’ respectively.
